title: Remimazolam versus propofol for deep sedation during Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) procedures. A randomized controlled trial.
official: Remimazolam versus propofol for deep sedation during Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) procedures. A randomized controlled trial.
summary: Main objective: To compare a remimazolam-based sedation regimen managed by endoscopists to a propofol-based sedation regimen performed by anesthesiologists during EUS gastrointestinal procedures.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients >18 years
2. Patients scheduled for elective EUS gastrointestinal procedures
3. Signed informed consent
4. Outpatient procedures
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients < 18 years
2. Patients scheduled for urgent EUS gastrointestinal procedures
3. Known contraindications to the use of propofol and/or remimazolam
4. Patient’s refusal to participate
5. Procedures that require orotracheal intubation
6. Pregnant and breastfeeding women
7. Inpatient procedures
